text.en: Did the carol once sing of "three poor shepherds"? Davies Gilbert's words of 1823, its earliest known printing, already say "certain poor Shepherds". William Sandys's book of 1833 has "three" in its words, but "certain" under its printed tune.
text.es: ¿Cantaba el villancico al principio "three poor shepherds" (tres pobres pastores)? La letra de Davies Gilbert de 1823, su primera impresión conocida, ya dice "certain poor Shepherds" (unos pobres pastores). El libro de William Sandys de 1833 dice "three" en su letra, pero "certain" bajo su melodía impresa.

source.en: Davies Gilbert, Some Ancient Christmas Carols, second edition (London, 1823), Carol IX, p. 28; William Sandys, Christmas Carols, Ancient and Modern (London, 1833), pp. 74 and 75 and the air "The First Nowell"; read from the scans
source.es: Davies Gilbert, Some Ancient Christmas Carols, segunda edición (Londres, 1823), villancico IX, p. 28; William Sandys, Christmas Carols, Ancient and Modern (Londres, 1833), pp. 74 y 75 y el aire "The First Nowell"; leído en los escaneos

text.en: The guide drops out: your part with the others only. Give me my note plays your first note quietly.

text.en: Once more on your own, from the top.

text.en: Record the tune of The First Noel in Sing, with the other parts playing.
text.es: Graba la melodía de The First Noel en Cantar, con las demás voces sonando.

text.en: The tune is one eight-bar phrase sung three times over, closing on the third note of the scale rather than the home note. In 1915 Annie Gilchrist suggested it began as a treble part sung above an old hymn tune.
text.es: La melodía es una sola frase de ocho compases cantada tres veces, y termina en la tercera nota de la escala en lugar de en la nota base. En 1915 Annie Gilchrist sugirió que nació como una voz de tiple cantada por encima de una antigua melodía de himno.

source.en: Annie G. Gilchrist, "Note on the Carol 'The First Nowell'", Journal of the Folk-Song Society, vol. 5, no. 19 (London, 1915), pp. 240 to 242, read from the scan
source.es: Annie G. Gilchrist, "Note on the Carol 'The First Nowell'", Journal of the Folk-Song Society, vol. 5, n.º 19 (Londres, 1915), pp. 240 a 242, leído en el escaneo
